beamng_fsr.title: AMD FSR Bridge
beamng_fsr.tagline: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution upscaling and frame generation for BeamNG.drive
beamng_fsr.description: Adds AMD FSR upscaling and frame generation to BeamNG.drive's Direct3D 12 renderer. This mod ZIP is only half of the integration: BeamNG's Lua sandbox cannot load native code, so the FSR work itself is done by a separate native bridge installed alongside BeamNG.drive.exe. See docs/INSTALL.md. Without the bridge this mod does nothing except tell you it is missing.
beamng_fsr.tag_line: AMD FSR upscaling and frame generation
beamng_fsr.license: MIT (mod). AMD FSR runtime is redistributed under AMD's own licence — see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
beamng_fsr.requirements: Windows 10/11, BeamNG.drive with the Direct3D 12 renderer, the native FSR bridge installed
